purpose: Frozen external-site replication of the JPL FairFlex policy matrix at the public Caltech ACN site. The Caltech August 1--31, 2019 file must not be acquired, inspected, or used until this configuration, its invariant test, and the protocol documentation are complete. The controller, policy set, guard architecture/rates, PV proxy capacity, feeder sensitivity, metrics, and inference are fixed; only site-local historical March fit and April calibration data are used as a deployment prerequisite.

acn_data_protocol.controller_information: At plug-in use the earliest complete declared kWhRequested and requestedDeparture. The later disconnectTime is a hidden environment event and must never be a controller input.
acn_data_protocol.unclaimed_session_policy: Exclude sessions without a complete initial commitment from the primary analysis.
acn_data_protocol.target_interpretation: Service ratio is delivered energy divided by user-declared requested energy, not historical delivered energy.

commitment_uncertainty.deployment_rule: At each plug-in each guard uses only Caltech April calibration scores and Caltech physical unplug outcomes already observed at or before that control step.
commitment_uncertainty.selection_protocol: Use the same multi_rate_envelope architecture and learning rates selected before the JPL primary test. Caltech April only initializes the calibration-score bank; it cannot select a mode, rate, policy, metric, or scenario. Caltech August is used only for external-site evaluation.
commitment_uncertainty.scope: External-site replication evidence only. Empirical coverage is operational and does not imply a finite-sample, conditional, per-driver, universal, or real-time deployment guarantee.

comparison_protocol.unit_of_inference: matched chronological calendar day; never individual EV session
comparison_protocol.shared_information_and_safety: Every policy receives the same declared commitment, causal multi-rate deadline guard, present-time PV-capacity source, station limits, synthetic feeder mapping, and AC execution validation.
comparison_protocol.round_robin_note: Because FairFlex models continuous power rather than discrete EVSE pilot-current increments, ideal Round Robin equals water-filled equal sharing. It remains visible for standards alignment but is not independent primary evidence.
comparison_protocol.runtime_interpretation: Report median and p95 per-day runtime descriptively; do not present faster runtime as a quality improvement without hardware-controlled experiments.
comparison_protocol.forbidden_actions_after_acquisition: Do not alter a policy, guard architecture/rates, metric, target definition, station mapping, feeder cap, or test window after the Caltech August file is acquired.

charging_data.station_assignment: deterministic hash of session ID across synthetic stations
charging_data.note: Real Caltech sessions are mapped to synthetic feeder stations; this is an explicit experiment assumption.

solar_data.note: Fixed regional GHI resource proxy; it is not measured Caltech rooftop PV output.

pv_proxy_sensitivity.note: PVWatts GHI proxy for a controlled sensitivity experiment; it is not measured Caltech PV production.

feeder_sensitivity.note: Deliberately severe synthetic shared feeder-import budget; it is not a measured Caltech feeder limit.
